approaches.name: Model-driven multi-view engineering
approaches.definition: Platform-independent models transformed into platform-specific models and artifacts.

approaches.name: Provenance-first representation
approaches.definition: Claims, artifacts, agents, activities, and derivations are first-class records.

approaches.name: Ontology and knowledge graph
approaches.definition: Concepts and relations are extracted and maintained across code, documents, and operations.

approaches.name: Inductive library learning
approaches.definition: Reusable abstractions are discovered from solved examples and held-out tasks.

approaches.name: Programming by example
approaches.definition: Examples and constraints specify behavior from which implementations are inferred.

approaches.name: Formal synthesis
approaches.definition: Candidate implementations are accepted only when independent checks satisfy explicit obligations.

approaches.name: Repository-scale change impact
approaches.definition: Requirements, architecture, code, tests, and documentation are linked for semantic impact analysis.

approaches.name: Structured AI workflow compilation
approaches.definition: AI work is represented as typed declarative modules and repeatable workflows.

approaches.name: High-level system definition
approaches.definition: A system is described as a set of domain concepts, responsibilities, boundaries, relationships, constraints, and observable outcomes before implementation details are chosen.
